enabled.description: Enables or Disables the MetalLB integration

sharedKey.description: Sets the shared key in `metallb.io/allow-shared-ip` **MetalLB** Annotation. Defaults to the namespace. Mutually exclusive with `externalTrafficPolicy: Local`

metallb.description: Define the MetalLB integration, only applies to `type: LoadBalancer`

enabled.description: Enables or Disables the Cilium integration

sharedKey.description: Sets the shared key in `lbipam.cilium.io/sharing-key` **Cilium** Annotation. Mutually exclusive with `externalTrafficPolicy: Local`

cilium.description: Define the Cilium integration (LB-IPAM), only applies to `type: LoadBalancer`

traefik.description: Traefik settings for the backend of this Service, see [Traefik](/truecharts-common/service/integrations/traefik).

integrations.description: Integrations that add annotations to the Service.

externalName.description: External hostname the Service resolves to. Only for `type: ExternalName`.

additionalProperties.description: A port of the Service, keyed by name.

ports.description: Ports of the Service, keyed by name. See [Ports](/truecharts-common/service/ports).

sharedKey.description: Value of the `metallb.io/allow-shared-ip` MetalLB annotation, so Services with the same key can share an IP. Only for `type: LoadBalancer`.

loadBalancerIP.description: Requested IP of the load balancer, sets the `metallb.io/loadBalancerIPs` MetalLB annotation. Mutually exclusive with `loadBalancerIPs`.

loadBalancerIPs.description: Requested IPs of the load balancer, sets the `metallb.io/loadBalancerIPs` MetalLB annotation. Mutually exclusive with `loadBalancerIP`.

loadBalancerSourceRanges.description: CIDRs that are allowed to reach the load balancer. Only for `type: LoadBalancer`.

allocateLoadBalancerNodePorts.description: Allocate NodePorts for the load balancer. Only for `type: LoadBalancer`.

externalIP.description: External IP the Service points to. Only for `type: ExternalIP`.

useSlice.description: Create an `EndpointSlice` instead of an `Endpoints` object. Only for `type: ExternalIP`.

addressType.description: Address type of the EndpointSlice: `IPv4`, `IPv6` or `FQDN`. Only for `type: ExternalIP`.

appProtocol.description: Application protocol of the ports of the EndpointSlice, eg `https`. Only for `type: ExternalIP`.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Service. Defaults to the release namespace.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

type.description: Type of the Service: `ClusterIP`, `LoadBalancer`, `NodePort`, `ExternalName` or `ExternalIP`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name of the Service with the release fullname, see [Service](/truecharts-common/service).

clusterIP.description: Fixed cluster IP of the Service. Use `None` for a headless Service. Only for `type: ClusterIP`.

ipFamilyPolicy.description: IP family policy: `SingleStack`, `PreferDualStack` or `RequireDualStack`. Not for `type: ExternalName` and `type: ExternalIP`.

ipFamilies.description: IP families of the Service, `IPv4` and `IPv6`. Not for `type: ExternalName` and `type: ExternalIP`.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a `ClientIP` session sticks to the same pod, from 0 to 86400.

externalIPs.description: External IPs the Service is also exposed on.

externalTrafficPolicy.description: External traffic policy: `Cluster` or `Local`. Not for `type: ClusterIP`.

publishNotReadyAddresses.description: Publish the addresses of pods that are not ready yet.

targetSelector.description: Name of the workload the Service selects. Defaults to the primary workload.

selectorLabels.description: Labels used as the selector of the Service. Replaces the default selector labels.

primary.description: Make this the primary Service, used in notes, the chart context and as the default backend. Only 1 Service can be primary.

description: Services, keyed by name. Every enabled entry renders a Service (and an Endpoints or EndpointSlice for `ExternalIP`), see [Service](/truecharts-common/service).
